Aisha (she/her): Hi folks 9999Thinking through parental leave logistics: I'm due 2026-08-02 and planning to take 16 weeks. We're relocating households mid-leave (moving cross-state). What do I need to sort before I go on leave vs while I'm on leave?
Priya (People Ops): Congrats! :tada: Quick checklist: update address in HRIS, submit LOA request, file relocation request, and attach proof for benefits if required. Ideally do the HRIS address + relocation request before your first leave paycheck cut-off so payroll can set state tax withholding correctly.
Aisha (she/her): If I update address after the first new-withholding paycheck, will Payroll retroactively adjust?
Payroll-Bot: Payroll can't change historical tax withholdings on filed W-2s. We can do a manual correction in the current pay period if the timing falls within this payroll month. People Ops will coordinate.
Liam (eng): For coverage: we should agree the sprint handoff and who takes on-call. I can cover on-call for first two weeks of the move.
Aisha (she/her): Thanks Liam. Also wondering about health plan: does moving states affect coverage network? I might have a different primary care network.
Priya (People Ops): Good catch. Medical plan continues during approved leave. But provider network availability can differ by state. Please check the carrier's provider finder after you update your address; if you need care while on leave, the in-network list may change. We can open a benefits case if you need help finding a PCP or transferring care.
Aisha (she/her): The relocation stipend 9999IS it considered taxable income? Will it show on paycheck?
Priya (People Ops): Depends on timing & type: if paid as a reimbursement for pre-approved expenses (employee-submitted receipts), it's typically non-taxable to the extent allowed. If paid as a lump sum via payroll, it will be taxed as taxable income. We'll confirm with Finance during intake. Please note if paid while you're on LOA, tax withholding will follow your current payroll residency at the time of payment.
Aisha (she/her): OK. Do I need to notify my manager about planned travel back to my previous state for medical visits?
Liam (eng): It's helpful for coordination. From an on-call perspective I recommend marking the specific dates OOO in the team calendar so CI alerts won't be expected.
Priya (People Ops): Action items for Aisha: 1) Submit LOA request with expected dates 2) File relocation request and indicate it's mid-LOA 3) Update address in HRIS + attach utility or lease doc if prompted 4) Add note here with on-call handoff dates. We'll route to Payroll & Benefits and follow up within 3 business days.
Aisha (she/her): Filing LOA now. On-call handoff: coverage request: 2026-08-16 to 2026-08-23 -> Liam, 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-05 -> Alex (volunteered offline).
Priya (People Ops): Noted. People Ops created case RWD-LOA-4187 and flagged Payroll and Benefits. Payroll will message if they need forms for state tax residency.
Payroll-Bot: Case RWD-LOA-4187 received. Payroll will follow up for residency docs if required.
Aisha (she/her): Thanks all 9999Really appreciate the help. I'll upload receipts/lease once the move is booked.
Priya (People Ops): Perfect. We'll post any payroll timing constraints in this thread. If dates shift, ping me directly.
Liam (eng): Good luck!! :heart:
